During our road trip along the Mumbai–Pune Expressway, we stopped at the Khaugalli Food Mall to take on the fun challenge of eating for just ₹200! With so many food stalls offering tasty dishes, we had to choose carefully to enjoy the best food without spending too much. We started at Kailash Sarovar, where we enjoyed a classic Ghee Dosa and Sabudana Khichdi, a great South Indian start. Next, we visited Egg Sunday for a delicious Half Fry Up. At ATR, we had nutritious Ghee Podi Millet and Bene Idli. To cool down, Yo Boba served us a refreshing Lemon Iced Tea, perfect for the hot highway weather.

We didn't want to miss Sai Sandwich, where the Chocolate Sandwich and Veggie Cheese Grill gave us a fun street-style snack. Then, we tried Shree Krishna Vada Pav, famous for their Vada Pav and Misal Pav combo, which felt like comfort food. At Good Luck Café, we enjoyed a rich Bun Butter Omelette and a cup of Tea, giving us that classic Irani café feeling on the go. To experience authentic Maharashtrian flavors, we stopped at Aapla Maharashtra for Pithla with Bhakri. For some North Indian street snacks, Kailash Parvat served us spicy Raj Kachori and crispy Panipuri. Finally, our trip ended on a tasty note at South & More, where we had Filter Coffee and Ghee Dosa. Each place was special and full of delicious flavors, making this ₹200 food challenge an exciting and tasty adventure filled with local favorites!

snippet.title: Aligarh Numaish Food 2025 | Street Food In Aligarh | Aligarh Exhibition 2025
snippet.description:
Aligarh Numaish is not just an exhibition; it's also a paradise for food lovers. As you walk through the fair, the delicious smell of kebabs, biryani, and sweets like Nan Qatai and Halwa Paratha fills the air. From Nahari, Korma and Mutton Mandi  to rich desserts, there’s something for everyone. It’s a place where you can enjoy the tasty flavors of Aligarh while exploring the lively stalls and attractions.

Aligarh Numaish is scheduled in the month of February every year and it is a must visit place for food enthusiasts.

You can call it Aligarh Numaish 2025 or Aligarh Exhibition 2025 you can find everything you need in it.

Food in this video:
Mutton Mandi at Shalimar Restaurant Aligarh
Hyderabadi Dum Biryani at Shalimar Restaurant Aligarh
Nahari at Shalimar Restaurant Aligarh
